components.css: .ds-label{display:block;font:600 .875rem/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#302b36);margin-bottom:6px}.ds-field{width:100%;min-width:0;border:1px solid var(--field-border,#b9b2c0);border-radius:6px;background:var(--paper,#fff);color:var(--ink,#302b36);padding:10px 12px;font:15px/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;caret-color:var(--plum,#4d385d)}.ds-field:hover{border-color:#8c7e96}.ds-field::placeholder{color:#746d7a;opacity:1}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#9c742b);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Main navigation
components.description: White navigation with plum active underline.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Main navigation"><button class="ds-nav-link ds-current" aria-current="page">Write comments</button><button class="ds-nav-link">Class overview</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:30px;background:var(--paper,#fff);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#dfdbe3)}.ds-nav-link{min-height:48px;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;padding:10px 0 8px;color:var(--muted,#6b6471);background:transparent;font:600 .875rem/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-nav-link.ds-current{border-bottom-color:var(--plum,#4d385d);color:var(--plum,#4d385d)}.ds-nav-link:hover{color:var(--plum,#4d385d)}.ds-nav-link:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#9c742b);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Writing-group tabs
components.description: Three broad groups with a brass selected underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#dfdbe3)}.ds-tab{min-height:49px;padding:12px 0 10px;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#6b6471);font:600 .875rem/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}.ds-tab:hover{color:var(--plum,#4d385d)}.ds-tab[aria-selected="true"]{color:var(--plum,#4d385d);border-bottom-color:var(--brass,#b78836)}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#9c742b);outline-offset:3px;}

components.css: .ds-surface{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:28px;padding:24px 28px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--paper,#fff);color:var(--ink,#302b36);font:15px/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif}.ds-title{margin:0;font-size:1.375rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-helper{margin:8px 0 20px;color:var(--muted,#6b6471);font-size:.8125rem}.ds-aside{padding-left:28px;border-left:1px solid var(--line,#dfdbe3)}@media(max-width:800px){.ds-surface{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:20px;gap:24px}.ds-aside{padding:20px 0 0;border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#dfdbe3)}}

components.name: Selected phrase
components.description: A full wrapping sentence with native radio state and selected tint.
components.css: .ds-phrase{display:flex;align-items:start;gap:12px;border:1px solid #d9d3de;border-radius:6px;padding:16px;color:var(--ink,#302b36);font:400 .875rem/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-phrase:hover{border-color:#b8a6c4;background:#faf7fc}.ds-phrase.ds-chosen{background:var(--plum-tint,#f0e9f4);border-color:#897096}.ds-phrase input{accent-color:var(--plum,#4d385d);width:17px;height:17px;flex:0 0 17px;margin:3px 0 0;padding:0}.ds-phrase input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#9c742b);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-phrase span{overflow-wrap:anywhere}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-phrase{transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out}}

narrative.overview:
The Focused writing desk is a calm, practical writing environment. A compact plum masthead anchors white work surfaces on lavender-white canvas; brass is a small orientation cue. Familiar system sans keeps attention on student names and complete phrases.

The built interface uses restrained underlines, visible field boundaries, and tonal selection states. Its personality comes from proportion, whitespace, and useful text rather than decorative imagery. There are no shipping raster assets.
keyCharacteristics: White editing surfaces with plum interaction states.
Quiet underline navigation and clearly bounded controls.
Tonal draft feedback with a distinct final writing surface.

rules.name: The Brass Orientation Rule
rules.body: Use brass for the selected writing-group underline; keep primary actions and selected text plum.

rules.name: The Readable Phrase Rule
rules.body: Show full phrases in wrapping text, with text labels and native radio state supporting the selected tint.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Keep work surfaces flat. Reserve cast shadows for dialogs and transient toast feedback.

dos: Do use the existing plum, brass, lavender-white, and white roles.
Do keep navigation quiet and selected states visibly distinct.
Do show full phrases and preserve a separate final editor.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't expand every phrase category into a competing tab.
Don't add decorative raster imagery or shadows to ordinary work surfaces.
